name: stretchlim_double_bins
comment: stretchlim histogram bin count by class vs MATLAB R2025b. DEEP-PROBE 2026-05-31 (toolbox pivot, toolboxes/image): stretchlim hardcoded a 256-bin histogram for ALL classes, so on a DOUBLE/single image the limits were coarsely quantized to k/255 — stretchlim([0.1 0.2 0.9 0.95]) gave [26/255 242/255] = [0.1019608 0.9490196] instead of MATLAB's 65536-bin result [6554/65535 62258/65535] = [0.1000076 0.9499962]. MATLAB uses 256 bins for uint8 but 65536 for uint16/int16/single/double. Fix: NBINS = (uint8 ? 256 : 65536). uint8 input is unchanged (s2 = [10/255 250/255] = [0.0392157 0.9803922]); double linspace(0,1,100) -> [0.0101015 0.9898985]. imadjust's auto default (which calls stretchlim) tracks the corrected limits. covers:[stretchlim].
